hardware.rtl_constraint: feedback_fir with TAPS=512 sets `fresh` only after exactly 512 coefficients; 256 coefficients leave fresh=0 and the run faults (capture_status bit18)

scheme.chosen: zero-pad the logical model to the hardware tap count at load time
scheme.why_not_bitstream: no verified 256-tap bitstream exists for the current RTL; rebuilding and re-verifying one costs a Vivado run plus a full regression for no mathematical difference
scheme.equivalence: the padded coefficients beyond the logical taps are exactly 0, so the convolution is identical to the 256-tap model
scheme.labelling_rule: a padded 256 model is NEVER described as a trained 512 model; the evidence records logical_taps and loaded_taps separately
scheme.requires: B written confirmation that zero-padding is the agreed equivalence (requested, not yet received)

measured_on_board.note: one direct-mode trial, gain 0 dB, white-noise source, 1.8 s

verdict: zero-padded loading verified on hardware: loaded_count=512, fresh set, and the replay arithmetic is bit-exact against the padded coefficients
